description: Every tests/v1_programs program that `oracle diff` does not classify MATCH against Forge, and every known difference family of the generated corpora, with its diagnosis, the SPEC rule, the evidence and the owner of the fix. Tracked, not accepted: SPEC-v1 §8.4 and CLAUDE.md principle 2 require 0 POTENTIAL_SILENT_WRONG on the gate corpora, so W4/F1 is not signed off while any POTENTIAL_SILENT_WRONG entry is listed here. Checked against a live oracle by `cargo test -p forge-cli --test oracle_gate -- --ignored` (every other program must be MATCH, each listed one must have exactly its class, and every POTENTIAL_SILENT_WRONG difference of a family program must have the family's signature; with AICAD_ORACLE_GATE_DIRS it also checks generated corpora: every POTENTIAL_SILENT_WRONG difference must have a family signature or belong to a program listed under `generated`); remove an entry in the same change that makes it MATCH.

families.signature: an `edges` row where the oracle has 1 or 2 more edges, or an `edge_types` row where only conic types (`circle`, `ellipse`) differ and the oracle has 1 or 2 more of each
families.rule: SPEC-v1 §8.3 rule 1: the same-domain merge re-merges what OCCT split along seams; a circular or elliptic arc that crosses a periodic face's seam must be one edge, as Forge reports it
families.evidence: seam_boss_over_hole and seam_notch_in_disk (hand-counted); 509 of the 517 POTENTIAL_SILENT_WRONG programs of the generated runs below have only rows of this family (1 of them with ellipses, gen1_s5_00051)
families.last_seen: not seen on 2026-09-25 (integrator: v1 classic seed 61 x 1000, v1 ops seed 61 x 1000, the v1 error corpus, tests/v1_programs; kernel-fixes: v1 seed 47 x 1000 MATCH=1000): W7b's §8.3 rule 1 seam normalizations; remove the family once seeds 5, 11 and 23 are re-diffed without it

families.signature: a `faces` row where the oracle has 1 more face, or a `face_types` row where only periodic types (`cylinder`, `cone`, `sphere`, `torus`) differ and the oracle has 1 more (its rims are oracle-seam-split-arcs rows)
families.rule: SPEC-v1 §8.3 rule 1: periodic faces that OCCT split along seams are re-merged
families.evidence: seam_split_hole_wall_face (gen1_s23_01337 reduced, reproduced); generated gen1_s5_01905, gen1_s23_01337, gen1_s23_01883
families.last_seen: not seen on 2026-09-25 (integrator: v1 classic seed 61 x 1000, v1 ops seed 61 x 1000, the v1 error corpus, tests/v1_programs; kernel-fixes: v1 seed 47 x 1000 MATCH=1000): W7b's §8.3 rule 1 seam normalizations; remove the family once seeds 5, 11 and 23 are re-diffed without it

families.signature: an `edges` row where Forge has exactly 1 more edge, or an `edge_types` row whose only difference is 1 more `line` in Forge
families.rule: SPEC-v1 §8.3 rule 1 and the v0 seam rule drop seam edges, not real edges between two faces that lie on a seam line
families.evidence: seam_edge_on_hole_seam (hand-counted, reproduced); generated gen1_s5_01279, gen1_s11_01378, gen1_s11_01890 (each has a Forge edge between a hole wall and a cut face on the hole's seam line)

programs.diagnosis: the pocket's corner pokes 0.0011 mm out of a hole of e4 (a 0.0014 x 0.0018 x 0.25 mm sliver, 3.2e-7 mm3): Forge cuts it (e4 modified, 11 faces); the oracle's `meets` threshold (1e-6 mm3 at this scale) leaves e4 untouched
the oracle recognizes 2 of the 6 spiric pocket-wall/torus sections as circles (plus one seam-split arc)

generated.robustness: not POTENTIAL_SILENT_WRONG, listed for the MATCH rate. 2026-09-24 runs: Forge failed revolves of profiles with a rounded corner on the axis with INVALID_RESULT (FORGE_UNBOUNDED_DOMAIN; fixed by the kernel fixes: a horn torus), one boolean FORGE_BOOLEAN_INCONSISTENT (gen1_s5_01347), and 3 programs whose sketch-on-face probe matches 2 OCCT faces in the oracle's replay (gen1_s5_01098, gen1_s23_00745, gen1_s23_01729). 2026-09-25 runs: gen1_s61_00125 (classic): a body with the new horn tori (r_in = 0) makes every later boolean on it FORGE_BOOLEAN_UNSUPPORTED (`boolean/geom.rs` rejects minor >= major), even for a tool that misses it — W4 capability gap; 12 ops programs: OCCT_SHELL_FAILED on a notched box shelled open on its notched top (a known OCCT limitation, W7b `engine_limits`), Forge verified against the generator's closed form; gen1x_s61_00209: the pending §8.1 key tie-break (two bodies' coplanar bottom caps), which the ops family does not filter (W7b open issue)
